description: Reset a commercial prep bench: clean beneath its movable tray, collect crumbs, wipe mixed food/oil/water, protect clean staging, dispose of dirty cloths and release the tools.
count_scope: named material-composition presets; seeds vary patch and crumb placement, not independently qualified tasks

evaluator.scope: Native mass and object state; no visual-coverage score, sanitization or autonomous-solution claim. The sticky-food preset uses task revision 2 (BenchResetProgress, own instruction, score 1.0 only on success); reference and oil-heavy keep revision 1 (Progress).

qualification: Previous release withdrawn after failed sustained-rest, held-wipe and visual review. Requalification is in progress; see wiping/REOPENED.md. Historical component passes do not qualify the current environment.
